source: Foundation 12 Daily Practice · Week 1 (student booklet + teacher answer key)
title: Monday Daily Practice · Speaking
subtitle: Shadowing, spelling, three-sentence answers, introduce a classmate
intro: Speaking practice. Work alone for about 60 minutes. Send photos of 5C, 5D and 5E and voice notes for 5D and 5E.
send_today: Send: photo of 5C–5E + voice notes (5D answers, then 5E paragraph), by 23:00 today.

steps.title: 5A · Shadowing
lines: How do you pronounce this word?
I want to improve my accent.
My hometown is in Thanh Hóa province.
I'm a freshman at a university in Thanh Hóa.
My ambition is to become a doctor.
steps.note: Shadowing: listen 2 times, then say the sentence with the audio 3 times. Same speed, stress and pauses. Bold = stressed syllable.

steps.title: 5B · Letter sounds
steps.instructions: Say each letter group aloud 2 times: /eɪ/ A H J K · /iː/ B C D E G P T V · /e/ F L M N S X Z · /aɪ/ I Y · /əʊ/ O · /uː/ Q U W · /ɑː/ R. Then spell aloud your surname, first name, hometown and major.

open.q: Spell your surname, first name, hometown and major.

steps.title: 5C · Questions and answers
steps.instructions: Write the letter of the matching answer (a–f).

steps.title: 5D · Three-sentence answers
steps.instructions: In IELTS Speaking, a good answer = answer + reason + example. Write 3 sentences for each question, read them aloud 3 times, then record (voice note).

open.q: 1. Where's your hometown? What is it like?
2. What's your major? Is it difficult?

steps.title: 5E · Introduce a classmate
steps.instructions: Use your notes from the class survey. Write 6 sentences (he's/she's, his/her), read them aloud 3 times, then record (voice note).

open.q: This is ______. He's / She's from ______. His / Her major is ______. He's / She's (not) a freshman. His / Her hobby is ______. His / Her ambition is to become a ______.

steps.title: ★ Challenge · 45-second introduction, take 2
lines: Say your introduction without reading (use the Session 2 handout, Part 6). Record two takes and send the better one in the group.
steps.note: Optional. Record two takes and send the better one.
